symbolic_lemmas.decides: E^2(a) >= rho_floor > 0 for all a  =>  H never reaches 0  [memo Eq. (3.1); memo Sec. 3(e) case 2]

symbolic_lemmas.lemma: L2 zero-crossing quintessence: SEC at turnaround is automatic
symbolic_lemmas.decides: rho_tot = 0 forces V = -(rho_m + phidot^2/2) < 0, and then rho_tot + 3 p_tot = 3(rho_m + phidot^2) > 0 identically [memo Eqs. (3.7), (3.8)]

symbolic_lemmas.lemma: L3 zero-crossing k-essence: SEC at turnaround is automatic and the crossing is compatible with no-ghost/c_s^2>0
symbolic_lemmas.decides: rho = 2X P_X - P = K X + 3 L X^2 + V crosses zero when V < -(rho_m + K X + 3 L X^2); at that point rho_tot + 3 p_tot = 3(rho_m + 2 K X + 4 L X^2) > 0, while K + 6 L X > 0 keeps the mode healthy

symbolic_lemmas.lemma: L4 CPL rho_DE(a) > 0 for every a (no zero crossing)
symbolic_lemmas.decides: rho_DE(a) = rho_0 a^{-3(1+w0+wa)} e^{-3 w_a (1-a)} is a product of strictly positive factors, so it decays to 0+ and is never negative [memo Eq. (4.1)]

symbolic_lemmas.lemma: L5 interacting dark sector with a sustained drain crosses zero
symbolic_lemmas.decides: with Q/H = -xi rho_crit0, rho_DE(u) = Omega_DE0 - xi u reaches zero at u = Omega_DE0/xi and goes negative after; the drained energy reappears in the pressureless sector, rho_c -> xi/3 floor [memo Sec. 3(e) case 1]

symbolic_lemmas.lemma: L6 constant negative effective Lambda: turnaround exists but flatness forces Omega_m > 1
symbolic_lemmas.decides: E^2 = Omega_m a^-3 - |Omega_L| = 0 at a_t = (Omega_m/|Omega_L|)^(1/3); flatness gives Omega_m = 1 + |Omega_L| > 1, excluded at the observed matter density [memo Eq. (3.6) and Sec. 3(c)]

cross_table.name: Cosmological constant Lambda
cross_table.rho_p: rho_Lambda = Lambda c^2/(8 pi G) = const > 0, p = -rho c^2
cross_table.deciding_equation: E^2(a) >= rho_floor > 0 for all a  =>  H never reaches 0  [memo Eq. (3.1); memo Sec. 3(e) case 2]
cross_table.note: Memo Eq. (3.1): H^2 >= Lambda c^2/3 > 0 for every a. Memo Eq. (3.5): at Omega_m < 1 no positive Lambda permits recollapse at ANY curvature, so opening k > 0 does not help.

cross_table.name: Canonical quintessence (scalar with V(phi))
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: GENERALLY COMPATIBLE (weak early-time caveat) / TRIVIALLY_COMPATIBLE at the bounce
cross_table.rho_p: rho = phidot^2/2 + V, p = phidot^2/2 - V
cross_table.turnaround: PASS (sub-class: V unbounded below / crossing zero)
cross_table.deciding_equation: rho_tot = 0 forces V = -(rho_m + phidot^2/2) < 0, and then rho_tot + 3 p_tot = 3(rho_m + phidot^2) > 0 identically [memo Eqs. (3.7), (3.8)]
cross_table.note: Branch I's compatibility verdict concerns rho_phi at rho ~ M_Pl^4; the turnaround condition concerns V at a >> 1. Disjoint questions, both satisfiable (memo Sec. 3(d)).

cross_table.name: K-essence, L = P(X, phi)
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: LIKELY COMPATIBLE / TRIVIALLY_COMPATIBLE (X -> 0 canonical limit at the bounce)
cross_table.rho_p: rho = 2 X P_X - P, p = P
cross_table.deciding_equation: rho = 2X P_X - P = K X + 3 L X^2 + V crosses zero when V < -(rho_m + K X + 3 L X^2); at that point rho_tot + 3 p_tot = 3(rho_m + 2 K X + 4 L X^2) > 0, while K + 6 L X > 0 keeps the mode healthy
cross_table.note: Background phenomenology of the crossing is that of Class 2; the distinctive k-essence freedom is c_s^2, which moves growth, not background distances.

cross_table.name: f(R) dark energy (Hu-Sawicki-type, viable sub-class)
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: TRIVIALLY COMPATIBLE (Test I-2: the correction is 10^-122 of R_bounce)
cross_table.rho_p: rho_eff -> const > 0 asymptotically (the model is built to mimic Lambda today)
cross_table.turnaround: FAIL for the observationally viable sub-class
cross_table.deciding_equation: E^2(a) >= rho_floor > 0 for all a  =>  H never reaches 0  [memo Eq. (3.1); memo Sec. 3(e) case 2]
cross_table.note: Viability as DE today requires a positive asymptotic effective floor; the positive-floor lemma then forbids a turnaround. f(R) branches without that floor are not viable DE. No general f(R) criterion is claimed (memo Sec. 3(g)).

cross_table.name: Cubic Horndeski / kinetic gravity braiding
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: EFT_INAPPLICABLE (Q_S -> 0 at the bounce; M ~ H_0 << M_Pl) -- UNDETERMINED, not compatible
cross_table.note: Excluded from the intersection on the bounce axis by Branch I's own verdict; not promoted here.

cross_table.name: Non-minimally coupled scalar (xi R phi^2)
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: COMPATIBLE_WITH_CAVEAT (bounded tachyonic kick exp(sqrt(21 xi)); bound weaker than existing ones)
cross_table.rho_p: Jordan-frame effective density includes -6 xi H phi phidot
cross_table.deciding_equation: the turnaround condition (2.3) is frame-dependent for xi != 0: H = 0 in the Jordan frame is not Htilde = 0 in the Einstein frame, and no frame-invariant criterion is derived here (memo Sec. 3(g): model-by-model, no general criterion)
cross_table.note: GAP-1. This is the one class that is squarely inside Set B and whose Set-T status is genuinely open.

cross_table.name: Quartic/quintic Horndeski
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: TRIVIALLY_COMPATIBLE (pre-empted by GW170817: c_T = 1 forces G_4 = G_4(phi), G_5 = 0)
cross_table.rho_p: reduces to a non-minimally coupled scalar

cross_table.name: DHOST / beyond Horndeski
cross_table.note: Excluded on the bounce axis by Branch I's own verdict.

cross_table.name: Vacuum-energy sequestering (Kaloper-Padilla)
cross_table.rho_p: residual Lambda_eff = const, fixed by the spacetime four-volume
cross_table.turnaround: FAIL for the observed sign (Lambda_eff > 0 today)
cross_table.deciding_equation: E^2(a) >= rho_floor > 0 for all a  =>  H never reaches 0  [memo Eq. (3.1); memo Sec. 3(e) case 2]  [and, for the opposite sign, E^2 = Omega_m a^-3 - |Omega_L| = 0 at a_t = (Omega_m/|Omega_L|)^(1/3); flatness gives Omega_m = 1 + |Omega_L| > 1, excluded at the observed matter density [memo Eq. (3.6) and Sec. 3(c)]]
cross_table.note: The residual is a constant, so the class inherits the Lambda row exactly: a turnaround needs Lambda_eff < 0, which contradicts present-day acceleration.

cross_table.name: Interacting dark energy (DE-DM energy exchange)
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: COMPATIBLE (weak constraint: at rho ~ M_Pl^4 the dark-matter density is negligible)
cross_table.turnaround: PASS (sub-class: sustained drain, Q < 0 strong enough to take rho_DE,eff through zero)
cross_table.deciding_equation: with Q/H = -xi rho_crit0, rho_DE(u) = Omega_DE0 - xi u reaches zero at u = Omega_DE0/xi and goes negative after; the drained energy reappears in the pressureless sector, rho_c -> xi/3 floor [memo Sec. 3(e) case 1]
cross_table.note: The complementary sub-class -- any coupling that leaves rho_DE,eff > 0 asymptotically -- FAILS by the positive-floor lemma. Merely making w evolve is not enough (memo Sec. 3(e)).

cross_table.name: Massive gravity / bigravity
cross_table.branch_I_verdict: POSSIBLY NOT COMPATIBLE (Boulware-Deser ghost may reappear at Planck curvature) -- UNDETERMINED
cross_table.note: Excluded on the bounce axis by Branch I's own verdict.
